units.literal: Now you, sir, have had the fortune to roam in an age of emperors and kings, personally to wear the cap-strings and robes of office, to float amid brilliance and steep yourself in the Way and virtue, to gaze long on the patterns of dragon and tiger—this has gone on long.

units.zh: 卒不能攄首尾，奮翼鱗，振拔洿塗，跨騰風雲，使見之者景駭，聞之者嚮震。
units.en: Yet you never spread wings from the mud or ride the tempest so that sight of you would stagger the world.
units.literal: Yet in the end you cannot spread head and tail, flap scales and fins, struggle free of the mire, leap through wind and cloud, so that those who see you stand awestruck and those who hear you turn in admiration.

units.zh: 徒樂枕經籍書，紆體衡門，上無所蔕，下無所根。
units.en: You hug your books beneath a humble gate, tethered neither to high office nor to solid ground.
units.literal: You merely delight in pillowing your head on the classics and histories, folding your limbs within a plain gate, with nothing above to cling to and nothing below to root you.

units.zh: 獨攄意虖宇宙之外，銳思於豪芒之內，潛神默記，恆以年歲。
units.en: You send the mind past the sky while polishing thoughts on a pinpoint, brooding in silence year on year.
units.literal: Alone you let your thoughts wander beyond the cosmos and hone them finer than a hair's tip; you sink your spirit in silent memorization year after year.

units.zh: 然而器不賈於當己，用不效於一世， 雖馳辯如濤波，摛藻如春華，猶無益於殿最。
units.en: Still your talent finds no buyer today, your use no proof in this life; torrents of eloquence and springtime rhetoric win you no place in the merit roll.
units.literal: Yet your vessel is not priced in the market of the moment, your use is not tested in a single generation; though your disputation surges like breakers and your phrases unfold like spring blossoms, it still does no good in the ranking of first and last.

units.zh: 意者，且運朝夕之策，定合會之計，使存有顯號，亡有美諡，不亦優虖？」
units.en: Why not scheme for office and alliance so the living gain rank and the dead fine posthumous names—would that not be wiser?"
units.literal: Perhaps you should instead ply morning-and-evening stratagems, fix plans for alliance and conference, so that the living win glorious titles and the dead fair posthumous names—would that not be better?"

units.zh: 主人逌爾而咲曰：「若賓之言，斯所謂見勢利之華，闇道德之實，守穾奧之熒燭，未卬天庭而睹白日也。
units.en: The host smiled faintly and said, "What you say is what people call seeing the blossoms of power and profit while remaining blind to the substance of the Way and virtue, guarding a flickering candle in a hidden corner without ever lifting your eyes to the heavenly court to behold the bright sun.
units.literal: The host smiled faintly and said, "If that is your doctrine, it is what people call seeing the flowers of power and profit while blind to the fruit of the Way, guarding a guttering candle in a corner and never lifting your eyes to the celestial court to behold the bright sun.

units.zh: 曩者王塗蕪穢，周失其御，侯伯方軌，戰國橫騖，於是七雄虓闞，分裂諸夏，龍戰而虎爭。
units.en: Once royal roads rotted, Zhou lost control, barons raced abreast, and the seven powers tore China in a war of dragon and tiger.
units.literal: Formerly the royal highways were choked with weeds, Zhou lost the reins, marquises ran on parallel tracks, the Warring States raced crosswise; then the seven champions roared and wrestled, split the central states, and dragon fought with tiger.

units.zh: 游說之徒，風颺電激，並起而救之，其餘猋飛景附，煜霅其間者，蓋不可勝載。
units.en: Rhetoricians stormed in like wind and lightning, and hangers-on swarmed beyond counting.
units.literal: Wandering persuaders, swift as wind and lightning, rose together to rescue the age; the rest, like gales and flying shadows attaching themselves, flashed among them in numbers no carriage could carry.

units.zh: 當此之時，搦朽摩鈍，鈆刀皆能壹斷，是故魯連飛一矢而蹶千金，虞卿以顧眄而捐相印也。
units.en: In that chaos a blunt knife could decide a fate, so Lu Zhonglian felled a fortune with one shaft and Yu Qing dropped a premier's seal at a glance.
units.literal: In such a time, even a rotten twig or a dull blade could cut clean at one stroke; therefore Lu Zhonglian loosed a single arrow and toppled a thousand pounds of gold, and Yu Qing, with a glance, cast away the minister's seal.

units.zh: 夫啾發投曲，感耳之聲，合之律度，淫䵷而不可聽者，非韶、夏之樂也；
units.en: Shrill novelty may please the ear yet fail the scale—that is not the music of Shao and Xia;
units.literal: For twittering runs and tossed-off tunes that please the ear yet, set beside pitch and measure, prove lewd and unfit to hear—that is not the music of Shao and Xia;

units.zh: 因勢合變，偶時之會，風移俗易，乖忤而不可通者，非君子之法也。
units.en: and tactics that chase fashion until custom warps are not the gentleman's law.
units.literal: for opportunism that rides the moment, suits passing fashion, shifts custom, and ends in perverse blockage—that is not the gentleman's law.

units.zh: 及至從人合之，衡人散之，亡命漂說，羇旅騁辭，商鞅挾三術以鑽孝公，李斯奮時務而要始皇，彼皆躡風雲之會，履顛沛之勢，據徼乘邪以求一日之富貴，朝為榮華，夕而焦瘁，福不盈眥，禍益於世，凶人且以自悔，況吉士而是賴虖！
units.en: Think of the vertical and horizontal strategists and the exiles who peddled their arguments: Shang Yang used three techniques to insinuate himself with Duke Xiao, and Li Si exploited the needs of the age to win over the First Emperor. They caught the winds of opportunity and rode the turmoil of their times, seizing crooked chances to gain a day's wealth and honor. Glorious in the morning, by evening they were ruined; their good fortune did not last a moment, while their calamities burdened the age. Even evil men came to regret this path. How much less should a good man rely on it?
units.literal: When the vertical persuaders united men and the horizontal persuaders divided them, fugitives wandered about arguing and travelers displayed their rhetoric. Shang Yang carried three techniques to insinuate himself with Duke Xiao, while Li Si exerted himself in the urgent affairs of the age and won over the First Emperor. They all stepped into a conjunction of wind and cloud, trod a situation of upheaval, relied on narrow chances, and rode crooked paths in pursuit of a day's wealth and honor. In the morning they flourished; by evening they were withered. Their good fortune did not last the blink of an eye, while their calamities burdened the age. Even wicked men came to regret this; how much less should a good man rely on it!

units.zh: 且功不可以虛成，名不可以偽立，韓設辯以徼君，呂行詐以賈國。
units.en: Merit cannot be faked nor name bought: Han Fei angled his prince with rhetoric, Lü Buwei sold the realm by deceit.
units.literal: Moreover merit cannot be hollowly achieved, nor name falsely erected: Han Fei set sophistry to hook his ruler, Lü Buwei practiced fraud to traffic in the state.

units.zh: 說難既酋，其身乃囚；
units.en: Han Fei completed "The Difficulty of Persuasion," only to be imprisoned;
units.literal: When the "Difficulty of Persuasion" was finished, his person was imprisoned;

units.zh: 秦貨既貴，厥宗亦隧。
units.en: once Lü Buwei's Qin merchandise had fetched its high price, his clan too sank into the grave.
units.literal: when Qin's bribe had grown costly, his clan too went down the tunnel.

units.zh: 是故仲尼抗浮雲之志，孟軻養浩然之氣，彼豈樂為迂闊哉？
units.en: So Confucius fixed his mind above the clouds and Mencius fed the flood-like breath—were they merely eccentric?
units.literal: Therefore Zhongni set his will above drifting clouds, and Meng Ke nurtured the flood-like qi—did they delight in being impractical?

units.zh: 道不可以貳也。
units.en: The Way allows no divided loyalty.
units.literal: The Way does not admit doubleness.

units.zh: 方今大漢洒埽群穢，夷險芟荒，廓帝紘，恢皇綱，基隆於羲、農，規廣於黃、唐；
units.en: Great Han has cleansed the mire, cut the brambles, stretched the emperor's net wider than Fu Xi or Shen Nong, vaster than Huangdi or Yao;
units.literal: Now the great Han has swept away every stain, leveled peril, mowed the wilds, spread the imperial cord, widened the royal net; its foundation rises higher than Xi and Nong, its compass vaster than Huang and Tang;

units.zh: 其君天下也，炎之如日，威之如神，函之如海，養之如春。
units.en: its rule warms like the sun, awes like a god, holds all like the sea, and quickens like spring.
units.literal: in ruling all under Heaven it blazes like the sun, awes like a spirit, embraces like the sea, nurtures like spring.

units.zh: 是以六合之內，莫不同原共流，沐浴玄德，稟卬太和，枝附葉著，譬猶屮木之殖山林，鳥魚之毓川澤，得氣者蕃滋，失時者苓落，參天墬而施化，豈云人事之厚薄哉？
units.en: Within the six directions all drink one stream, bathe in hidden virtue, and cling like leaves to a tree; timing makes the growth, heaven and earth do the shaping—human whim weighs little.
units.literal: Therefore within the six coordinates none fail to share one source and one current, bathe in dark virtue, drink deep of supreme harmony, cling like branches and leaves; they are like plants growing in mountain forests, birds and fish breeding in rivers and marshes—those who catch the vapor flourish and multiply, those who miss the season wither and fall; Heaven and earth join to spread transformation—how can one speak of human affairs being thick or thin?

units.zh: 今子處皇世而論戰國，耀所聞而疑所覿，欲從旄敦而度高虖泰山，懷氿濫而測深虖重淵，亦未至也。」
units.en: Now you, sir, live in a glorious age yet discourse on the Warring States, dazzled by hearsay while doubting what you see. You would use a low mound to gauge Mount Tai and a puddle to fathom the abyss. You are nowhere near the mark."
units.literal: Now you, sir, stand in a brilliant age yet discourse on the Warring States, dazzle yourself with hearsay and doubt what your eyes see; you would measure Mount Tai with a yardstick from Dunhuang or fathom the abyss with a puddle from a marsh—you have not reached the mark."

units.zh: 賓曰：「若夫鞅、斯之倫，衰周之凶人，既聞命矣。
units.en: The guest said, "As for men like Shang Yang and Li Si, villains of failing Zhou—I have heard your command.
units.literal: The guest said, "As for men like Shang Yang and Li Si, villains of failing Zhou—I have heard your command.

units.zh: 敢問上古之士，處身行道，輔世成名，可述於後者，默而已虖？」
units.en: But did the ancients who kept the Way, aided their times, and left great names do it in silence?"
units.literal: May I ask: among men of high antiquity who kept their persons, practiced the Way, aided the age, and won names handed down—did they stay silent?"

units.zh: 主人曰：「何為其然也！
units.en: The host answered, "Why imagine such a thing?
units.literal: The host said, "Why should it be so?

units.zh: 昔咎繇謨虞，箕子訪周，言通帝王，謀合聖神；
units.en: Gao Yao advised Shun, Jizi counseled Zhou—their speech reached kings, their plans matched the spirits;
units.literal: Formerly Gao Yao counseled Shun, Jizi was questioned in Zhou—their words penetrated emperors and kings, their plans matched sages and spirits;

units.zh: 殷說夢發於傅巖，周望兆動於渭濱，齊甯激聲於康衢，漢良受書於邳沂，皆俟命而神交，匪詞言之所信，故能建必然之策，展無窮之勳也。
units.en: Fu Yue was revealed in a dream at Fuyan; Lü Wang's omen stirred on the banks of the Wei; Ning Qi's song rang out at the crossroads; and Zhang Liang received the book at the bridge at Xiapi. All awaited their appointed time and communed in spirit, relying on more than words; thus they could devise certain strategies and achieve immeasurable merit.
units.literal: The dream of Yin's Fu Yue arose at Fuyan; the omen of Zhou's Lü Wang stirred on the bank of the Wei; Qi's Ning Qi raised his voice at the broad crossroads; and Han's Zhang Liang received the book at the bridge at Xiapi. All awaited their appointed time and met in spirit, not through trust in spoken words; therefore they could establish certain strategies and unfold inexhaustible merit.

units.zh: 近者陸子優繇，新語以興；
units.en: Lu Jia, calm and unhurried, raised the New Discourses;
units.literal: In recent times Master Lu, leisurely and easy, raised the New Discourses to prominence;

units.zh: 董生下帷，發藻儒林；
units.en: Dong Zhongshu drew his curtain and lit the grove of scholars;
units.literal: Dong Zhongshu let down his curtain and sent brilliance through the Confucian grove;

units.zh: 劉向司籍，辯章舊聞；
units.en: Liu Xiang ordered the archives and clarified antiquity;
units.literal: Liu Xiang superintended the registers and sorted the old hearsay;

units.zh: 揚雄覃思，法言、大玄：皆及時君之門闈，究先聖之壼奧，婆娑虖術藝之場，休息虖篇籍之囿，以全其質而發其文，用納虖聖聽，列炳於後人，斯非其亞與！
units.en: Yang Xiong brooded out the Model Sayings and Great Arcana; each entered the ruler's gate, sounded the sages' chambers, ranged the field of learning, and left texts that shine for posterity—second only to the greatest.
units.literal: Yang Xiong pondered deeply and produced the Model Sayings and the Great Mystery: all reached the inner gates of the timely ruler, fathomed the inner rooms of former sages, wandered in the arena of arts, rested in the park of writings, thereby preserving their substance and releasing their pattern, were taken into the sage's hearing, and blaze in rows for later men—are these not next after the highest?

units.zh: 若乃夷抗行於首陽，惠降志於辱仕，顏耽樂於簞瓢，孔終篇於西狩，聲盈塞於天淵，真吾徒之師表也。
units.en: Then there were Boyi, who upheld his conduct on Mount Shouyang; Liuxia Hui, who humbled his aspirations to take a dishonorable post; Yan Hui, who delighted in his basket of rice and gourd of water; and Confucius, who brought his classic to an end with the hunt in the west. Their fame fills the space between heaven and the abyss; they are truly exemplars for men such as us.
units.literal: Or again, Boyi upheld his conduct on Shouyang; Liuxia Hui lowered his aspirations to accept a humiliating post; Yan Hui delighted in a basket of rice and a gourd of water; and Confucius ended his classic with the western hunt. Their fame fills the space between heaven and the abyss; they are true models for men such as us.

units.zh: 且吾聞之：壹陰壹陽，天墬之方；
units.en: I have heard that yin and yang are the square of heaven and earth;
units.literal: Moreover I have heard: one yin, one yang—this is Heaven and earth's square;

units.zh: 乃文乃質，王道之綱；
units.en: culture and substance are the twin cords of the kingly Way;
units.literal: both pattern and substance—this is the kingly Way's cord;

units.zh: 有同有異，聖喆之常。
units.en: sameness and difference are the sage's constant scales.
units.literal: having sameness and having difference—this is the constant of the wise and good.

units.zh: 故曰：慎修所志，守爾天符，委命共己，味道之腴，神之聽之，名其舍諸！
units.en: The ode says: polish your purpose, keep Heaven's tally, yield life to what is already yours, taste the Way's fat—when spirits listen, can fame stay away?
units.literal: Therefore it is said: carefully cultivate what you aim at, guard your Heaven-given tally, entrust life to what is already in yourself, taste the richness of the Way; when the spirits listen, will fame leave you?

units.zh: 賓又不聞龢氏之璧韞於荊石，隨侯之珠藏於蜯蛤虖？
units.en: Have you never heard how the He-bi jade slept inside a dull rock or Sui's pearl hid in a shell?
units.literal: Again, have you not heard that the He clan jade was wrapped in a Jing stone, or that the Marquis of Sui's pearl lay hidden in a mussel?

units.zh: 歷世莫眡，不知其將含景耀，吐英精，曠千載而流夜光也。
units.en: Ages passed before anyone knew they would blaze with inner fire and gleam in the dark after a thousand years.
units.literal: Age after age none saw them, not knowing they would hold radiant light and spit essence, idle a thousand years yet shed light by night.

units.zh: 應龍潛於潢汙，魚黿媟之，不睹其能奮靈德，合風雲，超忽荒，而躆顥蒼也。
units.en: The winged dragon wallowed in a puddle while minnows mocked him, blind to the day he would ride the storm into the blue.
units.literal: The responding dragon lurked in a muddy pool; fish and turtles despised him, not seeing how he could rouse numinous virtue, join wind and cloud, leap beyond the vast waste, and stand in the azure sky.

units.zh: 故夫泥蟠而天飛者，應龍之神也；
units.en: Mud-bound yet sky-soaring—that is the responding dragon;
units.literal: Therefore one who coils in the mud yet flies to Heaven is the spirit of the responding dragon;

units.zh: 先賤而後貴者，龢、隨之珍也；
units.en: cheap at first, costly later—that is the He jade and Sui pearl;
units.literal: one who is base first and honored later is the treasure of He and Sui;

units.zh: 時闇而久章者，君子之真也。
units.en: long hidden, long bright—that is the gentleman's truth.
units.literal: one who is dim for a time yet shines long is the truth of the gentleman.

units.zh: 若乃牙、曠清耳於管絃，離婁眇目於豪分；
units.en: When Ya and Kuang tune their ears to music, or Li Lou splits a hair's breadth;
units.literal: If then Ya and Kuang clear their ears to strings and pipes, and Li Lou strains his eyes to a hair's fraction;

units.zh: 逢蒙絕技於弧矢，班輸榷巧於斧斤；
units.en: when Peng Meng masters the bow or Lu Ban the adze;
units.literal: Peng Meng exhausts his skill on bow and arrow, Lu Ban measures his craft on axe and adze;

units.zh: 良樂軼能於相馭，烏獲抗力於千鈞；
units.en: when Wang Liang and Bo Le judge horses or Wu Huo hefts a thousand jun;
units.literal: Wang Liang and Bo Le surpass others in judging and driving, Wu Huo matches strength against a thousand jun;

units.zh: 龢、鵲發精於鍼石，研、桑心計於無垠。
units.en: Yi He and Bian Que mastered the needle and stone probe; Ji Yan and Sang Hongyang's financial calculations knew no bounds.
units.literal: Yi He and Bian Que brought their finest skill to needles and stone probes; Ji Yan and Sang Hongyang applied mental calculation without limit.

units.zh: 僕亦不任廁技於彼列，故密爾自娛於斯文。」
units.en: I am not fit to stack my small talent beside theirs, so I take quiet joy in these words alone."
units.literal: I, your servant, am not fit to crowd my petty skill among them; therefore I quietly take my pleasure in this writing."

units.zh: 太子曰：「顏子縮屋稱貞，柳下嫗而不亂，未若此翁白首不娶者也。」
units.en: The crown prince said, "Yan Hui was praised for chastity though he lived in a hovel, and Liu Xiahui kept his integrity though he shared a blanket with a woman—but neither can match this old man who has never married even to white hair."
units.literal: The crown prince said, "Yan Hui, who shrank in his hut, was called chaste; Liu Xiahui, who shared a blanket with a woman, was not corrupted—yet neither equals this old man, white-haired and never married."

units.zh: 時民近戰國，皆背本趨末，賈誼說上曰：筦子曰「倉廩實而知禮節」。
units.en: At the time popular life resembled the Warring States era, with everyone abandoning farming for marginal trades. Jia Yi urged the emperor, saying: Guanzi says, "When granaries are full, the people know ritual propriety."
units.literal: At the time the people were close to Warring States conditions, all turning from the fundamental to the marginal. Jia Yi persuaded the emperor, saying: Guanzi says, "When granaries are full, the people know ritual propriety."

units.zh: 於是上感誼言，始開籍田，躬耕以勸百姓。
units.en: Thereupon the emperor was moved by Jia Yi's words, first opened the imperial plow-fields, and personally plowed to encourage the people.
units.literal: Thereupon the emperor was moved by Jia Yi's words, first opened imperial fields and personally plowed to encourage the people.

units.zh: 漢之為漢幾四十年矣，公私之積猶可哀痛。
units.en: Even after decades, both state and household reserves remained fragile.
units.literal: Han has been Han nearly forty years, yet public and private accumulations are still pitiably painful.

units.zh: 民不足而可治者，自古及今，未之嘗聞。
units.en: No regime has stably governed a population in chronic deprivation.
units.literal: That people lacking means can still be governed-from ancient to present, this has never been heard.

units.zh: 古之人曰：「一夫不耕，或受之飢；
units.en: The ancients said, 'If one man does not farm, someone will go hungry;
units.literal: Ancients said: 'If one man does not farm, someone suffers hunger;

units.zh: 一女不織，或受之寒。」
units.en: if one woman does not weave, someone will suffer cold.'
units.literal: if one woman does not weave, someone suffers cold.'

units.zh: 生之有時，而用之亡度，則物力必屈。
units.en: If consumption outruns seasonal production, the economy inevitably buckles.
units.literal: Production has its timing, but use has no measure-then productive force must collapse.

units.zh: 古之治天下，至孅至悉也，故其畜積足恃。
units.en: Classical states built high-resolution management, which is why reserves were dependable.
units.literal: Ancient governance of the realm was meticulous to the finest degree; therefore their stores were sufficient to rely on.

units.zh: 今背本而趨末，食者甚眾，是天下之大殘也；
units.en: When society abandons productive fundamentals for secondary pursuits, macroeconomic damage follows.
units.literal: Now people turn away from root and rush to branch, while consumers are many-this is the realm's great injury;

units.zh: 淫侈之俗，日日以長，是天下之大賊也。
units.en: Escalating luxury culture is treated as parasitic extraction from real production.
units.literal: and luxurious, extravagant custom grows daily-this is the realm's great thief.

units.zh: 殘賊公行，莫之或止；
units.en: Predatory behavior has become normalized and unchecked;
units.literal: Injury and theft run openly, with none to stop them;

units.zh: 大命將泛，莫之振救。
units.en: political legitimacy itself is nearing systemic failure.
units.literal: the great mandate is about to drift, with none to rescue and stabilize it.

units.zh: 生之者甚少而靡之者甚多，天下財產何得不蹶！
units.en: A widening producer-consumer imbalance makes fiscal collapse unavoidable.
units.literal: Those who produce are very few while those who consume are very many-how can the realm's wealth not collapse!

units.zh: 失時不雨，民且狼顧；
units.en: Any weather shock immediately triggers social anxiety and scarcity behavior;
units.literal: If seasonal rain fails, people already look about like wolves;

units.zh: 歲惡不入，請賣爵、子。
units.en: In severe scarcity, people seek desperate liquidity-including status sales and family liquidation.
units.literal: if bad harvest yields no intake, they request selling ranks and even children.

units.zh: 既聞耳矣，安有為天下阽危者若是而上不驚者！
units.en: Given such warning signs, elite complacency is inexcusable.
units.literal: We have already heard this-how can the realm be in such peril and those above not be alarmed!

units.zh: 世之有飢穰，天之行也，禹、湯被之矣。
units.en: Famine and abundance are Heaven's recurrent course; Yu and Tang experienced them too.
units.literal: Ages have famine and abundance-this is Heaven's operation; Yu and Tang experienced it too.

units.zh: 即不幸有方二三千里之旱，國胡以相恤？
units.en: Large-scale drought requires coordinated interregional relief capacity.
units.literal: If by misfortune there is drought over two or three thousand li, how can the state mutually relieve it?

units.zh: 卒然邊境有急，數十百萬之眾，國胡以餽之？
units.en: Likewise, emergency mobilization needs strategic grain depth.
units.literal: If suddenly borders are urgent and crowds of hundreds of thousands arise, how can the state provision them?

units.zh: 兵旱相乘，天下大屈，有勇力者聚徒而衡擊，罷夫羸老易子而沦其骨。
units.en: Compound shocks of war plus famine produce social violence and extreme famine behaviors.
units.literal: When war and drought strike together, the world greatly bends: those with strength gather bands and attack; exhausted elders exchange children and gnaw their bones.

units.zh: 政治未畢通也，遠方之能疑者並舉而爭起矣，乃駭而圖之，豈將有及乎？
units.en: Without integrated governance beforehand, crisis response comes too late.
units.literal: If governance has not yet been fully connected, distant powers still able to doubt will all rise and contend; then to panic and plan, how could there be time?

units.zh: 夫積貯者，天下之大命也。
units.en: Strategic reserves are the state's core survival mechanism.
units.literal: Accumulated storage is the great lifeline of the realm.

units.zh: 苟粟多而財有餘，何為而不成？
units.en: With deep reserves, nearly all strategic aims become feasible.
units.literal: If grain is abundant and wealth in surplus, what objective cannot be accomplished?

units.zh: 以攻則取，以守則固，以戰則勝。
units.en: Reserves convert directly into offensive, defensive, and battlefield advantage.
units.literal: To attack, one takes; to defend, one is firm; to fight, one wins.

units.zh: 懷敵附遠，何招而不至？
units.en: Material strength also enhances diplomacy and long-distance attraction.
units.literal: Holding enemies and attaching distant peoples-what summons would not come?

units.zh: 今毆民而歸之農，皆著於本，使天下各食其力，末技游食之民轉而緣南畝，則畜積足而人樂其所矣。
units.en: Re-agrarianization and labor reallocation toward primary production would stabilize both reserves and social satisfaction.
units.literal: Now if we drive people back to agriculture, all fixed on the root, so everyone eats by labor and roaming eaters of secondary skills turn toward southern furrows, then stores suffice and people enjoy their place.

units.zh: 可以為富安天下，而直為此廩廩也，竊為陛下惜之！
units.en: The policy path to security is available, making current anxiety feel self-inflicted.
units.literal: This could enrich and secure the realm, yet we only remain trembling in fear-I secretly regret this for Your Majesty.

units.zh: 九月，鄂邑長公主、燕王旦與左將軍上官桀、桀子票騎將軍安、御史大夫桑弘羊皆謀反，伏誅。
units.en: In the ninth month, the Elder Princess of Eyi, King Dan of Yan, Left General Shangguan Jie, Jie's son Flying Cavalry General An, and Imperial Secretary Sang Hongyang all plotted rebellion and were executed.
units.literal: Ninth month, Eyi Elder Princess, Yan King Dan with Left General Shangguan Jie, Jie son Flying Cavalry General An, Imperial Secretary Sang Hongyang all plotted rebellion, suffered execution.

units.zh: 冬十月，詔曰：「左將軍安陽侯桀、票騎將軍桑樂侯安、御史大夫弘羊皆數以邪枉干輔政，大將軍不聽， 而懷怨望，與燕王通謀，置驛往來相約結。
units.en: In the tenth month of winter, an edict stated: 'Left General Marquis Jie of Anyang, Flying Cavalry General Marquis An of Sang Le, and Imperial Secretary Hongyang all repeatedly interfered in the auxiliary government with crooked and perverse actions. The Grand General would not listen, so they harbored resentment and communicated with King Yan in plotting, establishing post stations for coming and going and mutually agreeing to join together.
units.literal: Winter tenth month, edict said: Left general Anyang marquis Jie, flying cavalry general Sang Le marquis An, imperial secretary Hongyang all repeatedly with crooked perverse interfered auxiliary government, grand general not listen, and harbored resentment, with Yan King communicated plotted, established post stations come go mutually agreed joined.

units.zh: 而天厭梁德，上思匡繼，徒蘊包胥之念，終遘萇弘之眚。
units.en: Yet Heaven had turned from Liang; he still burned to restore the line—he kept Shen Baoxu's resolve, but met Chang Hong's fate.
units.literal: Yet Heaven tired of Liang virtue; above, he still thought to restore and continue—he only harbored the thought of Shen Baoxu, yet in the end met the calamity of Chang Hong.

units.zh: 故太史公著《龜策》、《日者》及《扁鵲倉公傳》，皆所以廣其聞見，昭示後昆。
units.en: Hence Sima Qian’s treatises on tortoise divination, day-selection, and the physicians Bian Que and Lord Cang—all to widen what we know and guide posterity.
units.literal: Thus Grand Historian Sima Qian wrote the “Treatises on Tortoises and Divination,” “The Day Diviners,” and the “Biographies of Bian Que and Lord Cang”—all to broaden knowledge and show the way to later generations.

units.zh: 隗囂素聞林誌節，深相敬待，以為持書平。
units.en: Wei Ao, who had long admired Du Lin's integrity, received him with great respect and named him examining clerk for palace documents.
units.literal: Wei Ao had long heard of Lin's purpose and integrity, treated him with deep respect, and appointed him examining clerk for palace documents.

units.zh: 囂復欲令強起，遂稱篤。
units.en: When Wei Ao tried to force him back to office, Du Lin pleaded a mortal illness.
units.literal: Ao again wished to make him forcibly rise, and he thereupon claimed grave illness.

units.zh: 囂意雖相望，且欲優容之，乃出令曰：『杜伯山天子所不能臣，諸侯所不能友，蓋伯夷、叔齊恥食周粟。
units.en: Wei Ao still wanted his service yet meant to indulge him, and issued a proclamation: 'Du Boshan cannot be bound as a subject to the Son of Heaven nor kept as a friend by any prince—he is another Boyi and Shuqi, ashamed to eat the grain of Zhou.'
units.literal: Ao's mind though still looked to him, and moreover wished to treat him with generous tolerance, thereupon issued an order saying, 'Du Boshan is one whom the Son of Heaven could not make his subject, whom the feudal lords could not make his friend—he is like Boyi and Shuqi, who were ashamed to eat Zhou grain.

units.zh: 林雖拘於囂，而終不屈節。
units.en: Though Wei Ao held him fast, Du Lin never compromised his principles.
units.literal: Although Lin was detained by Ao, to the end he did not bend his integrity.

units.zh: 建武六年，弟成物故，囂乃聽林持喪東歸。
units.en: In Jianwu 6 his brother Du Cheng died; Wei Ao finally allowed Du Lin to escort the body home to the east.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Jianwu, his younger brother Cheng died; Ao then permitted Lin to hold mourning and return east.

units.zh: 既遣而悔，追令刺客楊賢於隴坻遮殺之。
units.en: He regretted the decision as soon as Du Lin left and sent the assassin Yang Xian to waylay and murder him at Long Slope.
units.literal: After dispatching him he regretted it, and pursued with orders for the assassin Yang Xian to intercept and kill him at Longdi.

units.zh: 今且從師友之位，須道開通，使順所誌。』
units.en: For the present treat him as mentor and companion; when the road is clear again, let him follow his own resolve.'
units.literal: For now let him occupy the place of teacher-friend; wait until the Way is open and unobstructed, and cause him to follow what he purposes.'

units.zh: 東魏主不堪憂辱，詠謝靈運詩曰：「韓亡子房奮，秦帝魯連恥。
units.en: Unable to bear the anguish and humiliation, the Eastern Wei emperor recited a poem of Xie Lingyun: "When Han perished Zhang Liang rose in zeal; before the Qin emperor Lu Zhong felt shame.
units.literal: Unable to bear the anguish and humiliation, the Eastern Wei emperor recited a poem of Xie Lingyun: "When Han perished Zhang Liang rose in zeal; before the Qin emperor Lu Zhong felt shame.

units.zh: 贊曰：臣之姑充後宮為婕妤，父子昆弟侍帷幄，數為臣言成帝善修容儀，升車正立，不內顧，不疾言，不親指，臨朝淵嘿，尊嚴若神，可謂穆穆天子之容者矣！
units.en: Praise says: The minister's paternal aunt filled the rear palace as a Lady, and father, sons, and brothers served the curtains and canopy. Frequently spoke to the minister saying that Emperor Cheng was good at cultivating his appearance and conduct—ascending the chariot he stood upright, not looking back inward, not speaking rapidly, not pointing personally, facing court in deep silence, dignified like a god—can truly be called the august appearance of the Son of Heaven!
units.literal: Praise said: minister paternal aunt filled rear palace as Lady, father sons brothers served curtains canopy, frequently spoke minister said Cheng Emperor good cultivate appearance conduct, ascended chariot upright stood, not inward looked back, not rapid spoke, not personally pointed, faced court deep silent, dignified like god, can call solemn solemn Son of Heaven appearance indeed!

units.zh: 穰侯，昭王之舅也，權重於秦，威震鄰敵，有旦莫偃伏之愛，心不介然有間，然范雎起徒步，由異國，無雅信，開一朝之說，而穰侯就封。
units.en: Marquis Rang, uncle to King Zhao of Qin, dominated that state and awed its neighbors; he shared the king's pillow and board without a shadow between them—yet Fan Ju, a stranger on foot, won a single hearing and sent Rang packing to his domain.
units.literal: Marquis Rang was King Zhao of Qin maternal uncle; his weight of power was in Qin, his awesomeness shook neighboring enemies; he had morning-and-evening couch-bending love, his mind was not stuck with a gap—yet Fan Ju rose from walking the roads, came from a different state, had no long-standing trust, opened one morning persuasion, and Marquis Rang went to his fief.

units.zh: 願將軍由周公之謙懼，損穰侯之威，放武安之欲，毋使范雎之徒得間其說。」
units.en: I urge you to keep the Duke of Zhou's humility, shed Marquis Rang's arrogance, and curb the appetites that ruined the Marquis of Wu'an—lest another Fan Ju find a crack through which to speak."
units.literal: I wish the general would take the Duke of Zhou humble fear, diminish Marquis Rang awesomeness, release the Marquis of Wu an desires, and not let a Fan Ju class obtain a gap for his persuasion."

units.zh: 成帝性寬而好文辭，又久無繼嗣，數為微行，多近幸小臣，趙、李從微賤專寵，皆皇太后與諸舅夙夜所常憂。
units.en: Emperor Cheng was mild and loved letters, long lacked an heir, often slipped out among petty favorites, while Zhao Feiyan and Li Ping from humble rank seized his love—the empress dowager and her brothers lost sleep over it.
units.literal: Emperor Cheng's nature was lenient and he loved literary phrasing; also long without heir, several times he made micro-journeys, drew near many petty favored ministers; Zhao and Li from mean base monopolized favor—all the Grand Empress Dowager and various maternal uncles night and day constantly worried.

units.zh: 又以掖庭獄大為亂阱，榜棰□於砲格，絕滅人命，主為趙、李報德復怨，反除白罪，建治正吏，多系無辜，掠立迫恐，至為人起責，分利受謝。
units.en: They turned the harem jail into a torture pit worse than the burning-pillar punishment, traded lives for Zhao and Li family vendettas, framed the innocent, extorted confessions, and invented debts to pocket bribes.
units.literal: Moreover they made the harem prison a great chaos pit; cudgels □ upon paoge, cutting off human lives; masters work Zhao and Li repaying grace and revenge, reverse clearing petty guilt, building cases against upright officials, binding many innocent, torture to force terror, even fabricating debts to split profit and take thanks.

units.zh: 郭解，河內軹人也，溫善相人許負外孫也。
units.en: Guo Xie of Zhi in Henei was the maternal grandson of Xu Fu, the famous face-reader from Wen.
units.literal: Guo Xie was a man of Zhi in Henei, maternal grandson of the physiognomist Xu Fu of Wen.

units.zh: 末嬉丧夏，褒姒毙周，妲已亡殷，赵灵沙丘。
units.en: Mojie drowned Xia, Baosi broke Zhou, Daji sank Yin, and King Ling of Zhao wasted away at Shaqiu.
units.literal: Mojie ended Xia; Baosi broke Zhou; Daji sank Yin; King Ling of Zhao died at Shaqiu.

units.zh: 臣聞秦丞相呂不韋見王無子，意欲有秦國，即求好女以爲妻，陰知其有身而獻之王，產始皇帝。
units.en: I have heard that Qin's chancellor Lü Buwei, seeing that the king had no heir, plotted to seize Qin: he found a beautiful woman, knew she was pregnant, and presented her to the king, and she bore the First Emperor.
units.literal: Your servant has heard that Qin chancellor Lü Buwei, seeing the king had no son, wished to possess the state of Qin; he then sought a fine woman as wife, secretly knowing she was with child and presenting her to the king, and she bore the First Emperor.

units.zh: 雖伯牙操遞鍾，逢門子彎烏號，猶未足以喻其意也。
units.en: Not even Boya on the Di Zhong harp or Fengmenzi drawing the Wuhao bow could capture the harmony of that meeting.
units.literal: Even if Boya grasped the Di Zhong zither, Fengmenzi bent the Wuhao bow, still they would not be sufficient to analogize its meaning.

units.zh: 間者，闊焉久不聞問，具有《春秋》對，毋以蘇秦從橫。」
units.en: We have heard nothing from you for an age—send a memorial worthy of the Spring and Autumn Annals, not the empty zigzag of Su Qin.'
units.literal: Of late, broad and distant, long without hearing inquiry—fully have a Chunqiu-type answer; do not use Su Qin's alliance-rivalry.'
